title: MULTIPLE CHOICE QUESTIONS PRACTICE & TIPS
description: Master multiple choice questions in IELTS listening with strategic approaches.
transcript: Welcome to the university library orientation. The library is open from 8 AM to 10 PM on weekdays and 9 AM to 6 PM on weekends. Students can borrow up to 10 books for a period of 3 weeks. Late fees are 50 cents per day per book. The library also provides access to online databases and research materials.

title: University Campus Tour: Multiple Choice
description: Practice multiple choice questions about university campus facilities and services.
transcript: Good morning everyone, and welcome to our campus tour. I'm Sarah, and I'll be your guide today. Our university was established in 1952 and has grown to accommodate over 25,000 students. The main library is located in the center of campus, next to the student union building. We have three dining halls, with the largest one serving over 2,000 meals daily. The sports complex includes an Olympic-sized swimming pool and a state-of-the-art gymnasium.

questions.question: When was the university established?
questions.explanation: The speaker clearly states that the university was established in 1952.

questions.question: How many students does the university accommodate?
questions.explanation: The speaker mentions that the university has grown to accommodate over 25,000 students.

questions.question: Where is the main library located?
options: In the center of campus, next to the student union
At the entrance of the university
questions.explanation: The speaker states that the main library is located in the center of campus, next to the student union building.

title: Job Interview: Multiple Choice Practice

title: Travel Information: Multiple Choice Practice
description: Advanced practice with travel information, airport announcements, and tourist guidance.
transcript: Attention all passengers. This is a general announcement regarding flight delays and cancellations due to severe weather conditions. Flight BA 1234 to London has been delayed by 3 hours and will now depart at 6:30 PM. Passengers on this flight should proceed to Gate 15 for updated information. Flight KL 5678 to Amsterdam has been cancelled. Affected passengers should contact the airline desk for rebooking options. The weather is expected to improve by evening, and we anticipate normal operations to resume tomorrow morning. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
